node.title: Observabilidad del proceso
node.summary: Reconstruct work, events and dependencies from observable evidence.

relations: Evidence-gated widening offers a design question for process discovery: when does another data source materially change the decision?
La búsqueda de rutas y la selección de fuentes son problemas distintos. Un criterio de ampliación debe evitar excluir procesos invisibles o grupos mal instrumentados.
Tuxpan provides a historical comparison for asking which observations are sufficient for a bounded operating objective.
Tuxpan precede al modelo y no lo valida. La frugalidad de sensores no prueba suficiencia de seguridad, cobertura ni interoperabilidad.
Operational traces can anchor a conservative estimate of compensatory work while leaving their coverage gaps explicit.
La telemetría puede omitir trabajo fuera de pantalla y confundir revisión necesaria con deuda. El paper es un protocolo, no un estimador ya validado.
In the supply-chain case, process traces were interpreted as evidence for architecture decisions rather than treated as a complete portfolio answer.
El texto público no acredita que todas las cadenas dispusieran de logs completos ni que process mining midiera por sí solo todo el ahorro del programa.
A reframing intervention may change both the formal representation of work and the operating flow subsequently used to evaluate it.
El cambio de marco no siempre causa un cambio operativo; documentar la secuencia y alternativas causales.
Better observation of an urban service does not by itself grant the authority to change an operator's commitments.
No se está reinterpretando el caso Tuxpan como aplicación histórica del contrato EA.
A declaration about how performance will be judged can change both reported information and the behavior being observed.
El ejemplo ilustra una distinción; no demuestra el teorema o todos los mecanismos del paper Cost of Clarity.
Operational tracking can close the loop between a process representation and the effects of decisions taken through it, rather than treating the diagram as a static description.
Una notación BPMN no demuestra causalidad ni garantiza que la captura observe todo el flujo.
Embedded field architecture can shorten corrective feedback between the operational flow and the representation used to change it.
La presencia en campo no da observabilidad total ni demuestra por sí sola causalidad o eliminación de fricción.
The GEPLAN field account illustrates how incident investigation exposed the operational information that implementation initially lacked.
La lectura retrospectiva no demuestra que el protocolo Cost of Clarity se utilizara entonces ni cuantifica su coste.
The independent occupancy channel illustrates the measurement discipline behind separating operational evidence from strategically asserted claims, while retaining each instrument's error model.
Independencia respecto del conductor no significa ausencia de sesgo ni valida por sí sola una estimación económica de contribución.
Introducing an observation rule can change the behaviour being measured; the Tuxpan account makes the purpose and adoption of telemetry part of the causal story.
No toda medición es una declaración constitutiva ni el cambio de conducta demuestra por sí solo aceptación del sistema.
